# lead-scraper-extension

> A Chrome extension that adds an "Add Lead" button to house listings on PropWire, Zillow, Homes.com and Trulia, saves the details and exports them to a spreadsheet.

If a person shared this repository with you, read the AI guide first.

## Start here
- [AI guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rger123/lead-scraper-extension/main/AGENTS.md): what it is, what to ask, setup steps, how to use it
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rger123/lead-scraper-extension/main/README.md)
